explanationMd: Expand: −6x+15>9, so −6x>−6. Dividing by −6 reverses the sign, giving x<1. Testing x=0 confirms it satisfies the original inequality.

distractorRationale.a: This introduces an incorrect sign while isolating x.
distractorRationale.c: This does not correctly distribute and combine the constants.
distractorRationale.b: Dividing by a negative number reverses the inequality.
